lines.text: Sargon king of Assyria sent his chief commander, who attacked and captured Ashdod.
The LORD told Isaiah to remove the sackcloth from his waist and the sandals from his feet.
Isaiah went naked and barefoot for seven years as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush.
The king of Assyria will lead away Egypt's captives and Cush's exiles, young and old, naked and barefoot.
Those who hoped in Cush and Egypt will be ashamed, and the valley dwellers will ask how they can escape.
